setNodeElevation._why: Grostè hub east apron, 1 of 4. East abutment / bottom of the 'Tapis Roulant Grostè Express - Fortini' magic carpet on the road viaduct. Ours read 1651 and Terrarium 1651, i.e. BOTH RASTERS AGREE AND BOTH ARE WRONG - an abrupt ~8 m step at a bridge head is exactly what a 30 m DEM erases - so elevationConsensus is structurally blind to it (it fires on disagreement). Ground truth 1642-1645 read off contours by the user, who also confirmed our WEST abutment n3986751322 (1649.7) is correct, so the error is one-sided. The whole east apron reads uniformly ~8 m high; all four nodes are pinned together per the atomic-patch rule (pinning part of a fault just moves the hole). Carpet stays east->west after this: |1649.7-1643| = 6.7 m is still under liftFlatDirectionM (10 m), so the drawn direction wins, and elevation alone would now agree anyway.

Grostè hub east apron, 2 of 4. Fortini Express gondola base. Ours 1655, Terrarium 1655, user's reading: level with the east abutment. Same shared-DEM-error patch as n1231572764. Note this also levels the 66 m novice link w1131930104 (oneway=no) between the two, which stays two-way.

Grostè hub east apron, 3 of 4. Grostè 1 express base. Ours 1648, Terrarium 1647, user's reading ~1640. Same patch. The 60 m synthetic flat traverse to n1231572764 keeps its 3 m drop and stays two-way.

Grostè hub east apron, 4 of 4, and the node that made the patch atomic. The junction above the two bases, ours 1657, user's reading ~1649 - the same ~8 m over-read as its three neighbours. It had to be pinned WITH them: w395878130 is a 57 m blue carrying an explicit oneway=no, so its reverse traverse is capped by maxTraverseClimb (8 m). Leaving this node at 1657 while dropping the abutment to 1643 would have turned a 6 m climb into 14 m and DELETED that reverse - a topology change caused purely by half-fixing an elevation fault. At 1649 it stays 6 m and nothing moves.
